content: Automotive loan interest rates at 15-year highs continue to dampen discretionary EV purchases globally. Raw material lithium carbonate deflation offers slight gross margin buffer.
Large block trades recorded selling $220 calls and buying $180 puts for December expiration. Dealer gamma position flipped negative below $215, intensifying downward sensitivity.

Regulatory scrutiny intensifies regarding Full Self-Driving claims in Europe, delaying regulatory approval until mid-2027. Q3 European delivery numbers contract 8% YoY amid intense domestic EV competition.
Retail sentiment deteriorated to 38/100 (Fear). Prominent tech commentators turn cautious regarding near-term autonomous robotaxi commercialization timelines.
Breakdown below the 50-day moving average on heavy selling volume. MACD histogram expands into negative territory with next major psychological support at $195.
